messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone. Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%, compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg, -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg, and -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg, compared with -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834)", "treatment groups", "Mounjaro 5 mg"]

The relation 'treatment groups' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject clinical trial or study included the treatment or intervention specified by the object entity as one of its treatment groups.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in study': The subject entity is used or tested in the study specified by the object entity.
B. 'compared with': The subject drug is compared to the object entity in clinical trials or studies.
C. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
